Mas1a f1_2:2.en: His sin offering which he missed a young bull a young one of the herd unblemished to YHWH for sin and he brought the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting
Mas1a f1_2:2.notes: Reconstructed text in positions 1 and 21. Uncertain text in positions 13, 14, 18, and 21.

Mas1a f1_2:3.en: before YHWH and he supported his hand upon the head of the bull and slaughtered the bull before YHWH and the anointed priest took
Mas1a f1_2:3.notes: The translation follows the visible transcription and morphology. The phrase evidence supports the rendering of key phrases, including 'before YHWH,' 'the head of the bull,' and 'the anointed priest.' The verb 'supported' is used for 'סמך' based on its visible morphology and the context-free gloss. The object marker 'את' is translated as 'his' based on the suffix 'יד׳ו.' The translation preserves the grammatical person, number, and semantic relationships. No uncertainty is present in the source text, and all recoverable words are accounted for.
